lede: The school board votes Tuesday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money being reallocated because the canyon took a hit, and worth knowing about. Alongside that, the Ethics Commission is shaping a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council, the Hospital District board could act on a Two Site Model that would define what gets built and where, and Mountain Village's HOA is moving to form a Workforce Housing Committee. A full week of decisions that will settle things for a while.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-driven budget changes to district's FY 2026-27 spending plan.
Commission drafts Code of Conduct recommendation that goes directly to Town Council.
CCAP funding discussion carries direct budget implications for county human services.
Board may act on Two Site Model, shaping scale and location of new medical facility.
Board votes on updated policies and forms a new Workforce Housing Committee.
